15.t: Working with data: how long does food stay?
q: In which part does food spend the most time?
Calculate the total time from mouth to the end of the large intestine.
Explain why food spends several hours in the small intestine.
It is where most digestion finishes and nutrients are absorbed; time lets enzymes work and molecules be taken in.
The mouth and oesophagus bars are almost invisible. Suggest a better way to show these data.
Use a table, or put time in minutes for short parts, or a log scale: values range from 20 seconds to 30 hours.
